name: Gyaruko-san
message: "...Huh? Why'd you stop? Did'ya spot Shiorin?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "What? You went to another world? Here? With Shiorin?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Huh? What the heck are you talking about?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Oh, so it's an urban legend. Occult stuff. So you actually experienced it? C'mon, explain it properly, or else I won't get it."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "So? What, you're heading to that world now? Shiorin's not there, right? There's no way she is."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "C'mon, quit messing around. We gotta stay focused, focused! Now let's get a move on."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Hey, what's up? I said we gotta get a move on."
Something's on the ground.

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "What's this?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "No, seriously, what *is* this...?"
(Pick it up)
It feels kind of weird.

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "No way you're picking that up, you're unreal. That thing's already giving me the creeps."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "How do I put it? It's like... the same vibe as when you bump into a ghost. Kinda like that, but not at the same time. You get me? Nope?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Point is, it's some kinda occult thing. I think."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "You think it's got something to do with that other world...? Kinda feels like it, yeah?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Hey, maybe that occult girl would know. This kinda stuff's her specialty, right?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "If you're curious, why not ask her? I don't really care either way."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "So yeah, up to you. For now, why not just take it? C'mon, let's go."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "You could just take it for now. Who knows, maybe some occult nut's gonna pay good money for it."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "If it sells, let's split—Wait, never mind. Money's useless to me."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "So yeah, do whatever you want. C'mon, let's go."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Okay, we're finding these pretty easily."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "This thing's kinda giving me the creeps... Way too sketchy."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Eh, might as well pick it up, yeah? Could come in handy."
(Pick it up)

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Don't lose it, mmkay? Alright, let's go."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "And there it is, another OOPArt."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "So uh, why's it just lying around like this...? Kinda wild nobody's picked it up. Way too sketchy."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "...But I guess people wouldn't just go picking up weird things on the ground. Yeah, that's just you."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Oh, I know. Maybe only people who can "see" stuff can see it. Yeah, that's probably it. Not that it matters, though."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Ain't this the last one? C'mon, grab it before someone else does."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "How many were left again? I forgot. Anyway, let's just grab it."
(Pick it up)

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Okay, time to hit our next stop~"
